definitions.explanation: A line or position established for defense against attack. Used literally in military contexts and figuratively for any last stand or boundary one tries to protect.

examples.japanese: {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}→突破：13755_toppa⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The last line of defense was breached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has become difficult to hold the line on profit margins amid price competition.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧ (defense) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). Used both literally for military defense positions and figuratively for any boundary or standard one tries to maintain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to set up a defensive line
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧: to break through a defensive line
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to hold a defensive line
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}: last line of defense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防御|ぼうぎょ}→防御：14575_bougyo⟧ライン: defense line — uses the loanword ライン
- ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧: front line — the forward-most position, not necessarily defensive
